## Description

A clinic list of outside labs. An ordered investigation (P2-018) can be sent out to a lab: sample, sent date, expected date. Status Sent → Received by lab → Reported, with history. The same lab list serves dental lab work (P8-018).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A send-out shows only the data the lab needs on its print or export.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each status change is recorded with who and when.
- [ ] **AC3.** Overdue send-outs (past expected date) are listed for the desk.

## Notes / open questions

- Pick up from DentalERP: `LabVendor` fields, `LabOrderHistory` pattern, status list of `LabOrderStatus`. Its work types are dental; pathology tests come from P2-018 instead.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
